An Exceptional Leg Day training with Nomaan Mukri at Plus Fitness Gym

I had a leg day session with Nomaan at Plus Fitness, and I am absolutely impressed by the quality of the training. I can't recommend him enough to anyone serious about making real progress.
The session began with a comprehensive 30-minute warm-up. I'll be honest, I never realised how much of a difference a proper warm-up could make until today. Nomaan's approach made my muscles feel activated and ready, which completely changed the effectiveness of the entire workout.

He guided me through multiple variations and masterfully showed how a small change in angle or form could target a completely different part of the muscle. It was a lesson in anatomy as much as it was a workout! He has a gift for pushing you beyond your comfort zone in the most encouraging way. With his guidance, I was able to safely increase both my repetitions and the weight, achieving more than I thought I was capable of.
Throughout the session, Nomaan shared invaluable knowledge about how to stabilise progress and ensure long-term gains. It's clear he is incredibly well-versed in how different bodies should be trained, considering factors like gender, age, and overall health to create a truly personalised experience.
We finished with a fantastic stretching session that left me feeling strong and mobile, not just exhausted. What truly sets Nomaan apart is his professionalism combined with a genuinely humble and supportive attitude. He makes you feel like a teammate on your fitness journey.
If you want a trainer who is not just a rep-counter but a true teacher and motivator, you must train with Nomaan. My perspective on training has completely changed for the better!

The only reason I'm still trapped in this hellhole is because it's the only gym close to my apartment. Otherwise, I would've run screaming in the opposite direction a long time ago.

The management here is an absolute joke. The owner? Forget about it. They're only interested in lining their pockets and couldn't care less about the actual members. Complaints? Ignored. Suggestions? Met with a blank stare. The air conditioning is constantly broken, so you're left sweating buckets while trying to work out. It's like a sauna in there, but without the relaxation. The equipment is old, poorly maintained, and often broken. Good luck finding a working treadmill during peak hours; it's a free-for-all.

And don't even get me started on the overcrowding. It's a constant battle for space. You're practically rubbing shoulders with everyone, and there's rarely a place to sit down, let alone stretch. The atmosphere is depressing, with everyone looking as miserable as I feel. I see no one who is actually happy in this gym. It's a breeding ground for frustration and disappointment. Honestly, it's the worst gym experience I've ever had, and I wouldn't recommend it to my worst enemy.
